$comment: Per-component Figma-generation config (see altitude-figma-generate skill). anatomyCase: legend shown, column direction, no state. caseAxes: Legend pairs with hideLegend. Orientation pairs with the new `direction` prop (2026-08-28) - it forwards to the group's own nested <al-layout> (gap md + wrap), so al-layout still owns arrangement; before that prop existed the plan measured `variant="horizontal"`, which no component ever had, so both cases rendered identically and the axis was honestly dropped while the design library's "Radio Group example" kept showing a Horizontal column. State is COMPOUND - driven by isError and isDisabled together, so it names both via `props` rather than one `prop`, and `implicitDefault` says a case with no State key IS State=Default. Both state rows are measurably distinct (Error adds an error-note subtree; Disabled adds theme/opacity/disabled to 11 nodes). sheet.cellWidth: this component's natural width exceeds the library's default 200px sheet pitch (sheet-style.mjs SHEET_CELL_WIDTH_PX), so its instances bled across the border-collapse grid lines and clipped their own helper text. Measured live 2026-08-27 from the widest instance in its own prop sheet, rounded up with breathing room. This is the documented per-component override the generator expects - do NOT re-measure instances inside the build (the sheet-style.mjs header explains why: ~30s per-call ceiling). nestedProps: al-radio's Figma set defaults to a variant this group never renders (Checkbox's default is Checked=Indeterminate, Label=Hidden), so nested instances came out as unlabelled indeterminate boxes; the curation switches them to the code's real default. al-field-note is POSITIONAL - the Error case renders helper-then-error, so entry 2 is the red one. $overrides make a nested instance follow the GROUP's own State axis (a Disabled group's radios read Disabled). Radio's set carries an Error state; Checkbox's does not, so only Radio gets the Error override. sheet.cellWidth raised to 430 for the Horizontal variants, which are ~386px wide and overflowed the narrower column-form pitch.
